richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bhubaneswar

c: Bhubaneswar is the capital of Odisha, a planned city known for its old temples and, more recently, for its universities, institutes and government campuses. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bhubaneswar to city parks, housing societies, schools, colleges, government colonies and corporate campuses. We make the Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai, about 1,360 km away, and deliver them by road.

The city is hot and humid for much of the year, the monsoon is heavy, and cyclones from the Bay of Bengal are a real risk in some seasons. An outdoor gym here needs galvanised frames, roto-moulded seats and handles, and footings that hold firm in strong wind. We recommend grouted installation for most sites in the city. Housing societies with a podium or paved garden can also use self-standing machines, which we confirm after looking at the surface.

items.q: Is grouted installation needed in Bhubaneswar?
items.a: For most open sites, yes. Grouting sets each post in concrete and keeps it steady in cyclone winds and on wet soil. Paved podiums may suit self-standing machines, which we confirm after seeing the site.

items.q: Can a government colony order outdoor gym equipment from you?
items.a: Yes. We send a list of suggested machines, a layout drawing with the clear zone marked, and a quote. Once approved, we manufacture, dispatch and install.

items.q: How do we look after the machines after a storm?
items.a: Keep the gym closed until it is dry, then check footings, joints and moving parts. Report any damage to aftersales@funplaysystems.com or call +91 738 530 0921.
